Manufacturing Authorization: The bidder should be an OEM or an authorized dealer/ reseller/ partn er of ‘Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM)’ of offered make of Long Range Terrestrial Laser Scanner (LiDAR Based). In suc h case, the bidder have to submit notarized copy of relevant valid ‘Au thorized dealership’/‘Business Partnership’ certificate from the manu facturer.

a) Only agencies submitting a Dealership or authorization ce rtificate issued by the manufacturer without reference to any sp ecific tender and having validity of such authorization for the co nsiderable duration shall only be considered for determining the eligibility of the bidder for the particular tender. Authorization is sued with reference to the specific tender in favour of particular dealer / bidder shall not be entertained. b) The bidder shall quote only latest updated models, which shall not be obsolete for at least next 7 years from the date of p urchase & whose spare parts and maintenance support is easily available. A certificate in this regard shall be provided from OEM . 2. Past Experience: The Bidder should have experience of having successfully complete d two similar works** (Supply of Long Range Terrestrial Laser S canner (LiDAR Based)) in last 7 years ending last day of month pr evious to the one in which tenders are invited. “Similar works”** means “Supply, installation/commissioning with at least one year Satisfactory performance of Long range Terrestria l 3D Laser scanner” In support of above, the bidders shall submit the notarized copy of S upply Orders/ Work Orders. The bidders shall also submit notarized copy of the following documents to establish successful completion and satisfactory performance of supplied Equipment of the awarded works: a) Bidders shall submit notarized copy of successful complet ion installation & Commissioning certificate signed/ issued by Pu rchaser/ Owner. b) In case Purchaser/ Owner issuing experience certificate is non-government entity, the bidders shall also submit notarized copy of Taxable invoice/ Delivery challan/ TDS certificate (if appl icable) for corresponding value of Supply Orders/ Work Orders issued by the Purchaser/Owner. c) Bidder shall submit notarized copy of performance certific ate for at least one years from the date of installation and com missioning issued by Purchaser/Owner. *Note: The reference date for considering the period for eligibili ty/qualification requirements above shall be the last day of the month previous to the one in which tenders are invited. 3. Financial Criteria: Estimated Cost = Rs 3,49,28,000/- i) Turnover Average Annual Turnover value of the bidder(s) in the preceding st three (3) financial years ending 31 March’2026 should not be les s than Rs 174.64 Lakhs as per the Annual Report (Audited Balan ce Sheet and Profit & Loss account) of the relevant period, duly au thenticated by a Chartered Accountant / Cost Accountant in India. ii) Working Capital: The Working Capital (current assets minus current liabiliti es) should be equal to at least 3 times the monthly cash fl

ow requirement i.e. Estimated cost of work*3/Supply peri od (Completion period = 2 months) i.e. INR 523.92 Lakhs. The working capital will be calculated as Current Assets minus Current Liabilities. For this purpose current assets and current liabilities will be considered as classified in the audited balance sheet f or FY 2025-26. However, tra de payables shall be a part of current liabilities. If the Wor king Capital calculated from the audited Balance Sheets i s negative then such working capital shall be treated as z ero. In case there is a shortfall in the Working Capital as p er this, the unutilized Cash Credit Limits sanctioned to the Bidder by the Banks/Financial Institutions of international repute shall be considered to meet the shortfall. The statement displaying Cash Credit limits should not be more than three months old as on the last date for submi ssion of bids. iii) Net-worth The Net Worth of the Bidder on the closing day of any 03 (three) F st inancial years out of last 05 (five) years ending 31 March’2026 s hould be positive. Net Worth’ means the aggregate value of the paid-up share capit al and all reserves created out of the profits, securities premium a ccount and debit or credit balance of profit and loss account, afte r deducting the aggregate value of the accumulated losses, deferr ed expenditure and miscellaneous expenditure not written off, as per the audited balance sheet, but does not include reserves crea ted out of revaluation of assets, write-back of depreciation and a malgamation. Note: Followings Documents to be submitted by bidder in suppor t of above Financial Criteria as under: (i) Bidder shall submit the copy of Annual Report / Standalone audited An nual Financial Statement containing Balance Sheet, Profit & Loss State ment, cash flow statement Auditor's Report thereon including all relev ant Schedules/ annexures etc. of last five(5) financial years as per req

uirement to establish financial criteria. (ii) In case where Audited financial results for the immediately precedin g year are not available, then a statement of account as on the closin g date of the immediately preceding financial year depicting the Wor king Capital, Turnover, Networth (calculated as per laid down criteri a) duly certified by their Statutory Auditor / Certified Public Accountan t carrying out the statutory audit shall be enclosed with the bids along with copy of appointment letter of the statutory auditor. (iii) Wherever, the Annual Report duly notarized copies of Audited Printed Annual Financial Statement are in language other than English, then c opy duly translated & printed into English language and certified by a pproved / recognized English translator shall be submitted with the Ap plication. (iv) For assessment, relevant pages of Annual Report containing Net Wort h figure duly certified by Authorized representative of Bidders, otherw ise, figure duly authenticated by the Statutory Auditors should be sub mitted. (v) The qualification given by Statutory Auditors on the Financial Statem ents which have impact on Net Worth, Turnover, Working Capital or any other financial item shall be taken into account for calculating the above financial parameters of Qualifying Criteria. In case of submitted documents issued by Chartered Accountant/ Co st Accountant, the UDIN of the Chartered Accountant/ Cost Accounta nt should be mentioned on these documents. 4. Declaration with sup porting documents in this regard is to be submitted by the Seller. How ever, all other eligibility criteria shall be applicable. 5. Exemption for MSEs: All Micro and Small Enterprises (MSEs) are exempted from meeting th e qualification criteria in respect of Prior Experience-Prior Turnover in public procurement for which necessary documents shall be submitte d by such seller. The seller must be the manufacturer of the offered pr

oduct i.e. Long range Terrestrial 3D Laser scanner. Traders are exclud ed from the purview of Public Procurement Policy for Micro and Small Enterprises However, all other eligibility criteria shall be applicable. 6. The bidder should submit notarized copy of valid ISO certification of the manufacturer (OEM) of offered Long Range Terrestrial Laser S canner (LiDAR Based). 7. Offered equipment shall comply with relevant BIS/American Standar d/European Standard etc. and in support of above necessary certificat e shall be submitted by the bidder. 8. The bidders or their OEMs should have their Service Center/ Support office preferably in Delhi/NCR. Documentary evidence duly notarized by notary public in this regard s hould be submitted by the bidder. 9. The bidder shall quote latest models whose service/maintenance is e asily available in Delhi NCR for next 07 years from the date of purchas e. 10. The bidders against whom proceedings for insolvency under the Insolv ency and Bankruptcy Code 2016 (as amended from time to time) have been started shall not be eligible for bidding.
